nodes.label: Cartograph (Scientific Metasearch Hub)
nodes.rationale: Operates as a Web-First React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA paired with a Node Local Bridge and Tauri v2 desktop wrapper, keeping Pro systematic review features 100% deterministic with zero LLM token cost (~95% margin) and full reproducibility.

nodes.label: Federated Academic Aggregator (15 Open APIs)
nodes.rationale: Queries 15 open scientific APIs in parallel via Promise.allSettled (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv, Crossref, DOAJ, Zenodo, HAL, DataCite, INSPIRE-HEP, Figshare, GBIF, OSTI.GOV, NASA NTRS) with canonical DOI/title deduplication and graceful per-source degradation.

nodes.label: Reactive Multilingual i18n Layer (PT, EN, ES, FR)
nodes.norm_label: reactive multilingual i18n layer (pt, en, es, fr)

nodes.label: Node Local Bridge (launcher-bridge.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Spawns native OS browser commands (cmd /c start, open, xdg-open) with 120ms tab throttling (~35 MB RAM, <5 MB overhead) so researchers retain active CAPES CAFe, EZProxy, and Zotero Connector browser sessions while bypassing 100% of pop-up blockers.

nodes.label: Curated Academic Platform Catalog (111 Platforms & 20 Presets)
nodes.norm_label: curated academic platform catalog (111 platforms & 20 presets)

nodes.label: Tauri v2 Standalone Desktop Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses Rust + OS native WebView (~45-80 MB RAM, 8-18 MB binary, 1280x860 window, @tauri-apps/plugin-opener) instead of Electron (250-450 MB RAM, 120-180 MB binary) to avoid duplicating Chromium and Node runtimes.

nodes.label: Multi-Format Citation Export & Bilingual Query Utilities
nodes.norm_label: multi-format citation export & bilingual query utilities

nodes.label: Strict Typing, Rate-Limit Resilience & WP:AISIGNS Standard
nodes.norm_label: strict typing, rate-limit resilience & wp:aisigns standard
nodes.rationale: Forbids implicit any, enforces defensive type-guards on external API payloads, requires graceful HTTP 429 degradation, and mandates Anti-Chatbotese (WP:AISIGNS) technical prose.

nodes.label: Deterministic Systematic Review & PRISMA 2020 Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Implements 3-tier deduplication (DOI, PMID/arXiv, Jaro-Winkler/Levenshtein), structured abstract parsing (MeSH/regex), PRISMA 2020 flow diagramming (SVG/PDF), and ABNT/APA/BibTeX/CSV export strictly deterministically to guarantee zero hallucinations and 100% reproducibility.

nodes.label: Graphify Query-First Token Optimization Protocol
nodes.rationale: Agents must query graphify-out/graph.json via query/path/explain before scanning files, read only targeted lines from source_location, and refresh incrementally via AST (/graphify . --update) to minimize LLM token overhead.
